context_notes: Everything durable is in files. The fixes are a ready patch at ~/.local/share/rndmroll-work/hardening.patch (22 files; README and two helper scripts beside it, including the local test-storage credentials, which are not in git). The scratchpad copies (hardening-work, hardening-base, results JSON) are session-local and may be gone; the patch is the source of truth. The static review found about 15 real defects, the biggest being a pre-existing hang on the splash screen when the stored refresh token has expired (deadlock in lib/api/client.ts), plus a network error at launch deleting the tokens, lost avatars, an upload size mismatch the storage rejects with 403, and an unverified-account takeover risk on social sign-in. Deliberately not changed: the routing flash on relaunch (only if step 7 or 18 shows it), the cold-start verification link dead end, OS permission text (needs a native rebuild), narrow-screen status row. Walkthrough steps 19 and 20 (Apple, Google) are deferred to the end of the project. After Phase 1, run /gsd-discuss-phase 2 interactively; Phase 5 builds the glass feed. The camera step needs a physical phone; the simulator has no camera.
